此.o: Origin unclear. Two possible explanations are (1) depicts a person (人) stopping (止), meaning "here", and (2) depicts a foot (止) kicking a person (人), based on an earlier meaning "to kick" (跐).
w: this, these; in this case, then
for this reason; with regards to this
x: 真的如此吗？
Zhēnde rúcǐ ma?
Is that so?
从来没有人如此关心我。
Cónglái méiyǒu rén rúcǐ guānxīn wǒ.
No one has ever cared about me like that before.
co: to be compatible with each other

两.o: Simplified form of 兩. Combination of two 丙 characters. 丙 also represents the sound.
w: both ends; both parties to a deal
x: 我们说的是两回事。
Wǒmen shuō de shì liǎng huí shì.
We are talking about different things.
你们这两天真够辛苦的。
Nǐmen zhè liǎng tiān zhēn gòu xīnkǔ de.
You've really been working hard the past few days.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

认.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 人 represents the sound.
w: to believe; to think; to consider
to know; to recognize; to be familiar with
to admit; to concede; to recognize
to declare to be untrue; to deny
x: 他认为在中国旅游很安全。
Tā rènwéi zài Zhōngguó lǚyóu hěn ānquán.
He thinks travelling in China is very safe.
你认识所有的字母吗？
Nǐ rènshi suǒyǒu de zìmǔ ma?
Do you know your ABCs?
你们应该认真地思考这个问题。
Nǐmen yīnggāi rènzhēn de sīkǎo zhège wèntí.
You should all think about this issue seriously.
co: to admit to saying the wrong thing

交.o: Pictograph of a person standing with crossed legs, conveying the meaning "to cross".
w: to give; to deliver; to hand over
to complete a contract; to reach a deal
to exchange; to swap; to switch (telecom)
x: 请把任务交给我吧！
Qǐng bǎ rènwù jiāo gěi wǒ ba!
Please assign me the task!
有劳你把信交给他。
Yǒuláo nǐ bǎ xìn jiāo gěi tā.
May I trouble you to deliver this letter to him?

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.
Shorthand for the phonetic 昜 component in the traditional character 傷.

伤.o: Simplified form of 傷. Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 昜 represents the sound.
w: to harm; to damage; to injure
x: 我伤了腿。
Wǒ shāng le tuǐ.
I injured my leg.
我越想越觉得伤心。
Wǒ yuè xiǎng yuè juéde shāngxīn.
The more I think, the sadder I feel.
伤口容易感染。
Shāngkǒu róngyì gǎnrǎn.
The wound can easily become infected.
co: yī wèi shǒubì shòushāng de nǚshēng
a girl with an injured arm
to rub salt in the wound

室.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 至 represents the sound.
x: 他到办公室去请假。
Tā dào bàngōngshì qù qǐngjià.
He went to the office to ask for leave.
麻烦您帮我接通书记办公室的电话，好吗？
Máfan nín bāng wǒ jiētōng shūjì bàngōngshì de diànhuà, hǎo ma?
Could you please connect me to the secretary's office?
co: two rooms and one living room

令.o: Depicts a person (卩) receiving commands from a mouth (口) above them.
w: to give an order; to command
to order; to enjoin; to charge
x: 谁传达的这道命令？
Shéi chuándá de zhè dào mìnglìng?
Who passed on this order?
令人发笑欢乐的事物。
Lìngrén fāxiào huānyuè de shìwù.
Something joyous that makes one laugh.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

护.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 户 represents the sound. Simplified form of 護.
w: to protect; to defend; to safeguard
to defend; to safeguard; to protect
to speak in defense of; to argue in favor of
to nurse; to tend and protect
to screen; to shield; to cover
x: 叫救护车！
Jiào jiùhùchē!
Call an ambulance!
她开始在想另一个办法保护她女儿的安全。
Tā kāishǐ zài xiǎng lìng yī ge bànfǎ bǎohù tā nǚ'ér de ānquán.
She had begun thinking of another way to ensure her daughter's safety.
co: officially protected site; officially protected entity

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

除.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 余 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "stair steps". The meaning later shifted to "divide", "remove", and "except".
w: only if (..., or otherwise, ...); only when
to eliminate; to remove; to exclude
to expel (a member of an organization)
to remove; to sack; to get rid of
to excise; to cut out (a tumor)
x: 除了他以外，谁也不肯去。
Chúle tā yǐwài, shéi yě bùkěn qù.
Except for him, nobody else is willing to go.
除了他以外，我也同意去。
Chúle tā yǐwài, wǒ yě tóngyì qù.
Besides him, I also agree to go.

c.h: The purpose of this component is unclear.

厤.o: Origin unclear. 秝 is a sound component.

c.h: The 口 component is sometimes used to indicate an abstract meaning taken from a concrete object. Here, the concrete object "shield" evokes the abstract meaning "firm, solid".

古.o: Depicts a shield. Based on the original meaning "firm, solid", which is now written as 固. The current meaning "old" is a phonetic loan.
w: to return to old ways (a Confucian aspiration)
people from ancient times; the ancients
x: 他对古董很有鉴赏力。
Tā duì gǔdǒng hěn yǒu jiànshǎng lì.
He has an eye for antiques.
游客们东张西望，对古老的街道充满好奇。
Yóukè men dōngzhāngxīwàng, duì gǔlǎo de jiēdào chōngmǎn hǎoqí.
The tourists gazed around, full of curiosity about the ancient streets.
co: yī zuò hěn gǔlǎo de jiànzhù

群.o: Phonosemantic compound. 羊 represents the meaning and 君 represents the sound.
w: (same as U+7FA3 羣) group, crowd, multitude, mob
in groups; large numbers of; grouping
to fit in; to get on well with others
x: 他从人群里钻了出来。
Tā cóng rénqún lǐ zuān le chūlái.
He squeezed his way out through the crowd.
警察一到现场，人群便四散离去。
Jǐngchá yī dào xiànchǎng, rénqún biàn sìsàn líqù.
The crowd soon dissipated when the police arrived.
co: to post to the wrong group
to join a group, to leave a group

層.o: Phonosemantic compound. 户 represents the meaning and 曾 represents the sound.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

判.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 半 represents the sound.
w: judgment (by a court of law); to sentence
x: 最终协议的谈判正在悄悄进行。
Zuìzhōng xiéyì de tánpàn zhèngzài qiāoqiāo jìnxíng.
Negotiations on the final agreement are progressing in secret.
本院决定对该案不予重新审判。
Běn yuàn juédìng duì gāi àn bùyǔ chóngxīn shěnpàn.
This court decided not to retry the case.

蹤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 從 represents the sound.

誤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 吳 represents the sound.

籤.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺮ represents the meaning and 韱 represents the sound.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

澤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 睪 represents the sound.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

汤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 昜 represents the sound. Simplified form of 湯.
w: boiled balls of glutinous rice flour, eaten during the Lantern…
to dawdle; to go slow deliberately
to go through water and tread on fire (idiom); not afraid of any…
x: 我们晚餐喝汤。
Wǒmen wǎncān hē tāng.
We will have soup for dinner.
元宵用水煮，随汤一起吃。
Yuánxiāo yòng shuǐ zhǔ, suí tāng yīqǐ chī.
Sweet dumplings are boiled and served in hot water.

盤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 皿 represents the meaning and 般 represents the sound.

c.h: 衤 is a component form of 衣.

裤.o: Simplified form of 褲. Phonosemantic compound. 衤 represents the meaning and 庫 represents the sound.
x: 爬起来吧，你会把你的裤子弄脏的。
Páqǐlái ba, nǐ huì bǎ nǐ de kùzǐ nòng zāng de.
Get up, you will make your pants dirty.
裤子太紧了。
Kùzi tài jǐn le.
These pants are too tight.
co: to pull someone's trousers down (to pants someone; to dack someone)

尤.o: Pictograph of a hand with a wart on it. The original meaning "wart" is now written as 疣. The original meaning later expanded to "strange, bizarre" and "outstanding, special".
w: especially; most of all; above all
(idiom) to blame the gods and accuse others
in order to warn against following bad examples (idiom)
x: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
Wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ, yóuqíshì píngguǒ.
I like fruit, especially apples.
这里的夏天尤其热。
Zhèlǐ de xiàtiān yóuqí rè.
The summers here are especially hot.

孤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 子 represents the meaning and 瓜 represents the sound.
w: lone; isolated and without help; all alone
x: 你并非孤军作战。
Nǐ bìngfēi gūjūnzuòzhàn.
You are not alone.
co: to die alone; to die a lonely death
to be socially isolated; social isolation

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

撤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 𢾿 represents the sound.
w: to repeal; to revoke; (computing) to undo
to withdraw; to leave; to retreat
to recall; to revoke; to retract
to retire; to remove; to withdraw
x: 我撤了。
Wǒ chè le.
I am leaving.
咱是不是该撤了？
Zán shìbùshì gāi chè le?
Shouldn't we get going?

烤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 火 represents the meaning and 考 represents the sound.
x: 快坐快坐，烤烤火。
Kuài zuò kuài zuò, kǎo kǎo huǒ.
Quickly take a seat and warm yourself by the fire.
培根在烤架上滋滋冒油。
Péigēn zài kǎojià shàng zīzī mào yóu.
The bacon is sizzling on the grill.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

潤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 閏 represents the sound.

啤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 卑 represents the sound.
x: 请来两杯啤酒。
Qǐng lái liǎng bēi píjiǔ.
Two beers, please.
我要了一瓶啤酒。
Wǒ yào le yī píng píjiǔ.
I asked for a bottle of beer.

c.h: Shorthand for the 鳥 component in the traditional character 鳳.

凤.o: Simplified form of 鳳. Phonosemantic compound. 鳥 represents the meaning and 凡 represents the sound. Originally a pictograph of a mythical Chinese bird, similar to a phoenix. Later the phonetic component 凡 was added.
w: lit. as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns (idiom)
the dragon and phoenix are symbols of good fortune (idiom)
x: 凤凰是传说中的一种鸟。
Fènghuáng shì chuánshuō zhōng de yī zhǒng niǎo.
The phoenix is a bird from legend.
这幅画上有一只美丽的凤凰。
Zhè fú huà shàng yǒu yī zhī měilì de fènghuáng.
There is a beautiful phoenix in this painting.

w: to be cynical; to be embittered
x: 听到这件事，大家都很愤怒。
Tīngdào zhè jiàn shì, dàjiā dōu hěn fènnù.
When they heard about this, everyone was very angry.
他气愤地离开了会议室。
Tā qìfèn de líkāi le huìyìshì.
He left the meeting room in anger.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

肤.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 夫 represents the sound. Simplified form of 膚.
w: skin; flesh; fig. close physical relationship
lit. cuts and bruises all over (idiom); fig. totally refuted
x: 皮肤光润。
Pífū guāngrùn.
The skin is smooth and radiant.

賤.o: Costing little 戔 money 貝; 戔 also provides the pronunciation

勤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 力 represents the meaning and 堇 represents the sound. Simplified form of 懃.
w: to be on duty (of a security guard etc)
to go to work; to be away on business
x: 你工作太勤奋了。休息一会吧。
Nǐ gōngzuò tài qínfèn le. Xiūxi yīhuì ba.
You're working too hard. Take a break for a while.

c.h: In ancient China, it was thought that the heart was the center of thought and reasoning.
Depicts a line piercing. Represents having an insightful understanding in one's thoughts.

悤.o: Depicts a line (囱) piercing a heart (心) (i.e. having an insightful understanding), conveying the meaning "insightful", now written as 聰. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

赤.o: Depicts the color of a large (大) fire (火).
w: equator (of the earth or astronomical body)
empty hand, empty fist (idiom); having nothing to rely on
x: 近朱者赤，近墨者黑。
Jìn zhū zhě chì, jìn mò zhě hēi.
Who keeps company with the wolf will learn to howl.
四渡赤水，是毛泽东军事生涯中的神来之笔。
Sì dù Chìshuǐ, shì Máo Zédōng jūnshì shēngyá zhōng de shénláizhībǐ.
The Four Crossings of the Chishui River is a masterstroke in Mao's military career.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

挤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 齐 represents the sound. Simplified form of 擠.
w: to squeeze out; to extrude; to drain
to squeeze; to press; to extrude
to crowd out; to push aside; to supplant
to break into; to force one's way into
to seize; to push aside and occupy
x: 再挤个人进来行吗？车里还有空吗？
Zài jǐ ge rén jìnlái xíng ma? Chē lǐ hái yǒu kòng ma?
Can you fit in another person? Is there room in the car?

煤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 火 represents the meaning and 某 represents the sound.
w: coal mining; coal extraction; coal cutting
x: 煤气罐炸了。
Méiqì guàn zhà le.
The gas tank exploded.
他们都被煤气熏死了。
Tāmen dōu bèi méiqì xùn sǐ le.
They all died being suffocated by coal gas.

唤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 奂 represents the sound. Simplified form of 喚.
w: to summon; to beckon; to call
to call out (a name etc); to shout
to waken (to action); to rouse (the masses)
to order sb about; to use sb
to cry out; to bark out a sound
x: 铃声将我唤醒。
Língshēng jiāng wǒ huànxǐng.
I was roused by the sound of a bell.
co: to awaken the people to the truth

斤.o: Pictograph of an adze for carving wood.
w: to haggle over every ounce; to split hairs
not much to choose between the two
Chinese unit of weight equal to 0.5 kg
x: 他体重不到五十公斤。
Tā tǐzhòng bùdào wǔshí gōngjīn.
He weighs less than fifty kilograms.
这袋子可盛五十公斤。
Zhè dàizi kě chéng wǔshí gōngjīn.
This bag can hold 50 kilos.

w: to shudder; to shiver; to shake
x: 她紧张得声音都颤抖了。
Tā jǐnzhāng de shēngyīn dōu chàndǒu le.
She was so nervous that her voice trembled.
树叶在风中轻轻颤动。
Shùyè zài fēng zhōng qīngqīng chàndòng.
The leaves quiver gently in the wind.

瘤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 留 represents the sound. Simplified form of 癅.
x: 纳粹主义是人类的毒瘤。
Nàcuìzhǔyì shì rénlèi de dúliú.
Nazism is a malignant tumor on humanity.
这个肿瘤是良性的还是恶性的？
Zhè ge zhǒngliú shì liángxìng de háishì èxìng de?
Is this tumor benign or malignant?

w: a sage; wise and holy man; virtuous ruler
a good wife and loving mother
great person of the past; venerable forebear
x: 她是大家眼中的贤妻良母。
Tā shì dàjiā yǎnzhōng de xiánqīliángmǔ.
In everyone's eyes she is a devoted wife and mother.

骤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 马 represents the meaning and 聚 represents the sound. Simplified form of 驟.
x: 请按照下面的步骤操作。
Qǐng ànzhào xiàmiàn de bùzhòu cāozuò.
Please follow the steps below.
昨晚气温骤降，今天很冷。
Zuówǎn qìwēn zhòujiàng, jīntiān hěn lěng.
The temperature dropped sharply last night, and today is very cold.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

濤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 壽 represents the sound.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

纤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 千 represents the sound. Simplified form of 纖.
x: 蔬菜里含有丰富的纤维。
Shūcài lǐ hányǒu fēngfù de xiānwéi.
Vegetables are rich in fiber.
她的手指又长又纤细。
Tā de shǒuzhǐ yòu cháng yòu xiānxì.
Her fingers are long and slender.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

攤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 難 represents the sound.

疤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 巴 represents the sound.
w: to form a scar; to form a scab

Tā de shǒu shàng yǒu yī dào shāngbā.
He has a scar on his hand.
我膝盖上留了一块疤。
Wǒ xīgài shàng liú le yī kuài bā.
I was left with a scar on my knee.

鉤.o: A metal 釒 hook 句; 句 also provides the pronunciation

c.g: an ancient state in Shandong province

w: lit. to follow the vine to get to the melon
x: 墙上爬满了常春藤。

紫藤花开了，非常漂亮。
Zǐténg huā kāi le, fēicháng piàoliang.
The wisteria is in bloom, and it is very beautiful.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

恤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 血 represents the sound. Simplified form of 卹.
w: to empathize with; to show solicitude for

to take pity; to show compassion

The boss is very considerate of the employees.
她很体恤父母的辛苦。
Tā hěn tǐxù fùmǔ de xīnkǔ.
She is very understanding of how hard her parents work.

c.h: 钅 is a component form of 金.

锤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 钅 represents the meaning and 垂 represents the sound. Simplified form of 錘.
w: lit. to fix the tone with a single hammer blow
after hard work and numerous revisions (idiom)
x: 请把锤子递给我。
Qǐng bǎ chuízi dì gěi wǒ.
Please pass me the hammer.
爸爸用锤子钉钉子。
Bàba yòng chuízi dìng dīngzi.
Dad is hammering in a nail.

ghost of one who died unjustly

Yuānwang ya, dàrén!

Zhōngguó hé Āfùhàn jiērǎng.
China shares a border with Afghanistan.

堤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 是 represents the sound. Simplified form of 隄.
w: (of a watercourse) to breach its dike
x: 河边修了一道很长的堤坝。
Hé biān xiūle yī dào hěn cháng de dībà.
A long embankment has been built along the river.
我们沿着河堤散步。

We took a walk along the river embankment.

跤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 交 represents the sound.

to fall down; to take a fall
x: 差点儿绊了我一跤。
Chàdiǎnr bàn le wǒ yī jiāo.
I tripped and almost fell.

A crane stood by the lakeside.

晤.o: Phonosemantic compound. 日 represents the meaning and 吾 represents the sound.

to speak face to face; meeting; interview

The first thing (I/we) saw was the estuary of Thames.
